chronology_firewall.next_allowed_operation_after_hash: construct exact periodic word atlas, then evaluate already-frozen G0/G1/G2 only

exact_radical_arithmetic_gate.binary64_role: presentation decimals only; never establishes EXACT
exact_radical_arithmetic_gate.canonical_sqrt_rational: for q=N/D in lowest terms, sqrt(q)=s/D*sqrt(r), where N*D=s^2*r and r is positive squarefree
exact_radical_arithmetic_gate.exact_equality: radical vectors identical coefficient-by-coefficient; rho=1 iff ratio vector equals {1:1}
exact_radical_arithmetic_gate.fallback: if a future expression exits a finite multiquadratic radical basis, use certified algebraic-number/interval separation and record it; no such fallback is expected for frozen chord sums
exact_radical_arithmetic_gate.input: every chord squared length q is exact positive rational
exact_radical_arithmetic_gate.ratio_to_single_radical: multiply numerator radical vector by sqrt(Q)/Q; reduce each product to canonical squarefree basis
exact_radical_arithmetic_gate.sum_representation: sorted map squarefree_r -> rational coefficient; zero coefficients removed
exact_radical_arithmetic_gate.teacher_period: sqrt(Q(t_period)) in the same radical vector basis

frozen_rule_evaluation.G0: frozen B1 G0 whole-chord winner for each k=2..8; no reselection
frozen_rule_evaluation.G1: all frozen B1 balanced programs by k and all frozen B1 minimum-RMSE reference programs by k; exact original predicate semantics; no modification
frozen_rule_evaluation.G2: frozen B1 class->composition lookup only; if a straight-edge packet class is absent from the frozen lookup, report NOT_AVAILABLE/UNSEEN and do not repair
frozen_rule_evaluation.all_cyclic_readout: Lhat_period=(1/k)*sum over every cyclic start in one fundamental period of the already-frozen composition-selected chord sum

fundamental_period.canonical_start: normalize each quotient vertex by an exact integer translation remainder along the x6/y6 period vector, then choose lexicographically least normalized vertex; outgoing edge is unique
fundamental_period.concatenation_check: replicate the lifted period by integer translations and compare exposed-edge instances against the direct half-plane exposure criterion for at least translations -2..2; exact integer equality only
fundamental_period.exposed_edge_orbits: for neighbor e_j with w_j=beta(e_j,n)>0, an occupied site with q=beta(x,n) exposes code j iff -w_j<q<=0. Since q is in gZ, orbit representatives are q=0,-g,...,-(w_j-g).
fundamental_period.kernel_generator: A=2na+nb, B=na+2nb, g=gcd(|A|,|B|); ker(beta(.,n))=Z*(B/g,-A/g); primitive sign is determined only by occupied-left boundary traversal
fundamental_period.minimality_certificate: gcd(|B/g|,|A/g|)=1, hence the kernel generator is primitive and is the minimal positive lattice translation up to sign
fundamental_period.word_construction: choose one Bezout u with beta(u,n)=g; site representative for q=m*g is m*u; form each oriented exposed Voronoi edge, quotient vertices by the primitive tangent translation, verify indegree=outdegree=1, traverse the unique quotient cycle, and lift once so endpoint-start equals one primitive tangent translation

lattice_and_metric.center_scaled_cartesian: axial (a,b) -> physical (a+b/2, sqrt(3)*b/2); integer carrier coordinates x6=6a+3b,y6=3b

local_identifiability.uses_only: frozen straight-edge periodic class atlas + frozen B2 role/class atlas

offset_classes.closed_tie_audit: h=m*g_n and h in [m*g_n,(m+1)*g_n) define the same occupied set; h just below m*g_n defines the previous threshold class, which is a lattice translate. Therefore exactly one digital-boundary word class up to lattice translation for every tangent family.
offset_classes.exact_classification: for h in Q let m=floor(h/g_n); because beta(x,n) is in g_n Z, H(n,h)=H(n,m*g_n)
offset_classes.image_subgroup: for n=(na,nb), A=2na+nb, B=na+2nb, g_n=gcd(|A|,|B|), beta(Z^2,n)=g_n Z
offset_classes.translation_equivalence: Bezout gives u in Z^2 with beta(u,n)=g_n; translation by m*u maps H(n,m*g_n) to H(n,0)

square_decomposition.bulk_formula_default: E_bulk(s)=2s[(rho_d-1)+(rho_p-1)] when exact period density applies in teacher length units
square_decomposition.finite_window_rule: if a boundary-layer offset is algebraically required, derive it from frozen periodic words; do not fit a slope/intercept

tangent_families.dedup_audit: D6 preserves Q; all eight tangent Q values are distinct, so no two are D6-equivalent; map to all discovery orientation/axis sources retained
tangent_families.source: both frozen square axes d and p for each of the 4 discovery orientations; p is frozen primitive exact perpendicular

teacher_free_half_plane.normal: primitive nonzero integer axial vector n
teacher_free_half_plane.translation_invariance: if beta(t,n)=0 then x in H(n,h) iff x+t in H(n,h)
